{{Quote|The Emperor is gone. Everyone who held him dear needs to rally together to keep the Empire alive. There are things you know that could help in that regard.''"<br />"''The Emperor enjoyed the ''Mantooine Minuet''. Does that help?|[[Ivak]] seeks Mara Jade's help|<ref name="Mara">[[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 3|''Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand'' 3]]</ref>}}
The '''''Mantooine Minuet''''' was a piece of [[Classical music|classical]] dance [[Music/Legends|music]],<ref name="CSWE" /> specifically a [[minuet]] composition.<ref name="Insider144" /> An innocuous piece of music, it passed review of the [[Imperial Board of Culture]] outright<ref name="Slugthrowers2">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> and was favored by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Following the Emperor's [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was captured by [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]]. Upon interrogation, Jade, who had identified herself as a dancer in the Imperial court, claimed that the Emperor enjoyed the ''Mantooine Minuet'' as a way of appearing obtuse about her real role.<ref name="Mara" /> ''Mantooine Minuet'' shared its name with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Mantooine Minuet'' was first mentioned in the [[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 3|third issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and [[Michael A. Stackpole|Michael Stackpole]] published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Mara" /> on [[October 7]]th, [[1998]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54455/star_wars_mara_jade_-_by_the_emperors_hand_1998_3|text=Star Wars: Mara Jade - By the Emperor's Hand (1998) #3}}</ref>
